$comment: Research data behind the Blockscout entries of the routing table (issue #169, decision 0038). It does not ship. Each candidate instance comes from Blockscout's chain registry (an explorer hosted by Blockscout, or a self-hosted one the issue named) or from Hardhat 3.21.2's built-in chain descriptors. Each was probed on 2026-11-05 with the fetch of Node.js 24.21.0, keyless, without following redirects; a redirect was followed by hand once and the target probed. instance is the host that answered both probes directly, or null; scripts/routing-seed.ts gives a chain a blockscout entry for each non-null instance. See ../2026-11-05-blockscout-instances.md.

probe.answers: An instance answers when the first gives HTTP 200 with backend_version and the second HTTP 200 with a status field.
